description: Add the in-process Mastra render tool for the poster template and prove it renders. Depends on FEAT-001 (sharp types + Anton font). Adds renderRasPosterStoryTool (createTool) in ras-render-tools.ts that builds props via preparePosterStory (Postertools.ts) with graceful logo fallback and renders <RasPosterStoryTemplate> through renderComponentToPng(RAS_CANVAS); registers it in src/mastra/index.ts; adds a one-shot render demo + npm script; and documents that template id 'ras-poster-story' is deliberately NOT part of the external Design Agent template_id enums (it is an in-process Satori template).
steps: In src/mastra/tools/ras-render-tools.ts, add `renderRasPosterStoryTool` via createTool, mirroring renderRasStoryTool. id: 'render-ras-poster-story'. inputSchema (zod): slug (string min 1), heroImage (string min 1 — url/path/dataURI/buffer source for makeHeroCutout), headlineTop, headlineMid, headlineHighlight (strings), categoryTag (string optional), accentColor (reuse the existing AccentEnum, optional), showMarkers (boolean optional). outputSchema: reuse RenderedAssetSchema plus a `ready: boolean` and `problems: string[]` so copy/image issues surface without throwing. Import preparePosterStory + loadLogoAsset from '../tools/Postertools.js' (same-dir: './Postertools.js') and RasPosterStoryTemplate from '../templates/RasPosterStoryTemplate.js'. Use '.js' import specifiers throughout.

In the tool's execute: resolve the logo via logoPath(...) from '../renderer/assets.js'. Because the only installed brand assets are SVGs and loadLogoAsset reads a RASTER PNG via sharp (it will throw on an SVG), only call loadLogoAsset when a raster .png exists at the resolved path (e.g. logoPath('ras-logo-black.png')); check existence with node:fs existsSync. When absent, build the BrandAssets-less path: call preparePosterStory with a brand whose logo fields are omitted — simplest is to pass `{ logoBase64: '', logoWidth: 0, logoHeight: 0 }` then delete the logo props from the returned props so the template takes the text-wordmark fallback (the template only draws the logo when logoBase64 && logoWidth && logoHeight are all truthy). Do NOT hardcode src/mastra/lib/public/... Build props = (await preparePosterStory({ heroSource: inputData.heroImage, headlineTop, headlineMid, headlineHighlight, categoryTag, accentColor }, brand)).props, overriding showMarkers when provided.

Render: component = React.createElement(RasPosterStoryTemplate, props); png = await renderComponentToPng(component, RAS_CANVAS); write to path.join(ensureRasOutputDir(sanitizeSlug(slug)), '01.png') via writeFileSync; return { success: true, slug, format: 'single', outputDir, assets: [{ index:1, file:'01.png', path, view_url: rasViewUrl(slug,'01.png'), download_url: rasViewUrl(slug,'01.png')+'?download=1', alt_text: `${headlineTop} ${headlineMid} ${headlineHighlight}` }], ready, problems }. Keep the tool non-throwing on bad copy/image (ready=false, problems populated) to match the makeHeroCutout convention.

Register renderRasPosterStoryTool in src/mastra/index.ts: add it to the existing `import { renderRasStoryTool, renderRasCarouselTool } from './tools/ras-render-tools';` import and to the tools:{} map.

Create src/mastra/demo/rasPosterRenderTest.ts (one-shot, pattern after rasRenderTest.ts header/env-load): (a) build a synthetic transparent hero PNG fully in memory with sharp — e.g. sharp({create:{width:800,height:800,channels:4,background:{r:0,g:0,b:0,alpha:0}}}).composite([{ input: <a small opaque png square buffer> }]).png().toBuffer() — so makeHeroCutout takes the alreadyCutout branch and skips the 140MB model; (b) call preparePosterStory({ heroSource: <buffer>, headlineTop:'AI MODELS GET', headlineMid:'A BIG UPGRADE', headlineHighlight:'SHIP IT NOW' }, { logoBase64:'', logoWidth:0, logoHeight:0 }) then strip logo props; (c) render via renderComponentToPng(React.createElement(RasPosterStoryTemplate, props), RAS_CANVAS); (d) assert the Buffer is non-empty and buf[0..3] === 0x89,0x50,0x4E,0x47; (e) assert loadFonts().some(f=>f.name==='Anton'&&f.weight===400); print PNG byte length + 'Anton present'. Exit non-zero on any assertion failure (process.exit(1) in catch).
Add npm script to package.json: "ras:poster:test": "npx -y tsx --env-file=.env src/mastra/demo/rasPosterRenderTest.ts".

Add a clarifying comment in src/mastra/tools/design-tools.ts next to TemplateIdSchema stating that 'ras-poster-story' is an IN-PROCESS Satori template rendered via renderRasPosterStoryTool and is intentionally NOT part of the external Design Agent template_id union. Do NOT add 'ras-poster-story' to design-tools.ts, instagram-tools.ts, x-tools.ts, newsToPostWorkflow.ts, newsToXWorkflow.ts, design-agent-client.ts, or aggregatorAgent.ts enums/lists.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run ras:poster:test` exits 0 and prints a non-empty PNG with a valid PNG signature and confirms Anton weight-400 is loaded, with NO logo binary present (text wordmark fallback) and no thrown error.
renderRasPosterStoryTool is registered in src/mastra/index.ts tools map.
No 'ras-poster-story' string was added to any external Design Agent template_id enum; a clarifying comment exists in design-tools.ts.
`npm run ras:render:test` still runs (existing RAS story path unbroken).
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm 0 errors.
Run `npm run ras:poster:test` and confirm exit code 0 with the PNG-signature + Anton-present output.

Run `npm run ras:render:test` and confirm it still executes without a regression in the existing RasStoryTemplate render path (it may legitimately report 'no usable image' when EXA is disabled — that is not a regression; a thrown error/compile failure is).
findings: Added renderRasPosterStoryTool (id 'render-ras-poster-story') to src/mastra/tools/ras-render-tools.ts, mirroring renderRasStoryTool: zod inputSchema (slug, heroImage, headlineTop/Mid/Highlight, optional categoryTag, optional AccentEnum accentColor, optional showMarkers) and outputSchema = RenderedAssetSchema[] plus ready:boolean + problems:string[]. execute resolves the black raster logo only when logoPath('ras-logo-black.png') exists via node:fs existsSync (the repo ships only SVGs and loadLogoAsset reads a raster PNG via sharp, which would throw on SVG); when absent it passes {logoBase64:'',logoWidth:0,logoHeight:0} to preparePosterStory and deletes the logo props so the template draws its 'Rise & Shine' text wordmark. Non-throwing: copy/image issues surface via ready/problems. Registered the tool in src/mastra/index.ts (import + tools map). Created src/mastra/demo/rasPosterRenderTest.ts (synthetic in-memory transparent hero -> makeHeroCutout alreadyCutout branch, skipping the ~140MB @imgly model; renders via renderComponentToPng(RAS_CANVAS); asserts non-empty PNG with 89 50 4E 47 signature and loadFonts() has {name:'Anton',weight:400}; process.exit(1) on failure) and added the ras:poster:test npm script. Added a clarifying comment next to TemplateIdSchema in design-tools.ts noting 'ras-poster-story' is an IN-PROCESS Satori template and intentionally NOT in the external Design Agent template_id union; no 'ras-poster-story' string added to any external enum. Verification: `npm run typecheck` = 0 errors; `npm run ras:poster:test` exit 0 (81852-byte PNG, valid signature, Anton present, no logo); `npm run ras:render:test` still runs (rendered a correct 1080x1350 PNG, existing story path unbroken). The GLib-GObject stderr lines during render are harmless native-lib warnings, not errors.
